rules.sentence: The dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma is a high-grade chondro-sarcoma with a less than 10% survival rate.
The treatment of chondrosarcoma is surgical excision, since cells are not chemosensitive or radiosensitive.
For high-grade lesions, wide or radical resection is recommended.
Pelvic and scapular chondrosarcomas have a high recurrence rate, and adjuvant chemotherapy does not improve survival rates.
Recommended treatment is wide excision to avoid recurrence.
Treatment is chemotherapy and wide surgical excision.
Treatment consists of curettage for low-grade lesions and wide excision +/radiation therapy for high-grade lesions.
